name: ac-ma-transaction-execution
description: Executing a merger or acquisition from term sheet to closing: structuring stock and cash consideration, the merger model and synergy analysis, accretion and dilution arithmetic, purchase price allocation after the deal closes, representations warranties and indemnities, working capital adjustments and the closing mechanism, regulatory clearance sequencing, and the written deal record. It explains how deals are structured and closed; it never recommends a transaction and never predicts an outcome. Use when asking "merger model", "accretion dilution", "purchase price allocation", "reps and warranties", "working capital adjustment", "deal structuring", "stock and cash consideration", "closing conditions", "antitrust clearance", "break-up fee", "synergy analysis". Not for trading the merger spread (ac-special-situations), not for primary equity issuance (ac-equity-capital-markets), not for the credit analysis of the combined company (ac-bank-and-credit-analysis).
